name: nix-eval
description: Evaluate Nix code in the browser with Tvix and WebAssembly
author: Diogo Correia <dv_correia@hotmail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:js && pnpm run build:types
scripts.build:wasm: pnpm run build:wasm:web && pnpm run build:wasm:nodejs
scripts.build:wasm:nodejs: wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir wasm/node --out-name nix_eval rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/nix_eval.wasm && mv wasm/node/nix_eval.js wasm/node/nix_eval.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:web: cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir wasm/web --out-name nix_eval rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/nix_eval.wasm
